blocks.text: Bogotá – Medellín: city tour and Comuna 13

provenance.rationale: Concise route heading composed from the corresponding day and its destination names.

blocks.text: Day 4 · Breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight to Medellín (not included). Welcome at José María Córdova International Airport and transfer to the hotel. Then a private city tour and Comuna 13 tour (7 hours): San Antonio Park, San Ignacio Square, Avenida La Playa, the Plaza Botero with more than 20 sculptures donated by Fernando Botero, the Park of Wishes, the Atanasio Girardot Sports Complex, the Convention Center, the old La Macarena bullring and the Pueblito Paisa; then El Poblado, with Poblado Park, Parque Lleras and the Golden Mile. Continue to Comuna 13, by Metro and Metrocable, to discover its graffiti and the murals of local artists, telling stories of change and hope, ending at its famous outdoor escalators.

blocks.text: Medellín – Piedra del Peñol and Guatapé

provenance.rationale: Concise route heading composed from the corresponding day and its destination names.

blocks.text: Day 5 · Breakfast, then a private excursion (8 hours) to El Peñol, with its replica of the original colonial town, and the majestic Piedra del Peñol, a granite monolith some 220 metres high; then the colourful town of Guatapé, famous for the zócalos, the decorated reliefs on its house fronts (explored by moto-taxi), and the reservoirs of El Peñol and Guatapé, where green mountains meet mirror-like water. Lunch included.
